featured_reviews.name: Dr Gorakh Bobde
featured_reviews.review_text: Our Lady of Good Counsel Church(OLGC)  is one of the oldest churches in Sion, Mumbai built by the Portuguese. It was built at Sion and was initially affiliated to the St.Michael Church at Mahim in 1596. Our Lady of Good Counsel Convent High School was established in 1939 as primary School later in 1958 as High on the premises of the Church.Its a co-ed school.The school has excellent extra curricular all round activities especially sports,Girls basketball team is well known..The is affiliated to the Maharashtra State Board of Education.

featured_reviews.name: Lizann Lobo
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Lady of Good Counsel Church in Sion is a beautiful and serene place of worship, offering a quiet space for reflection amidst the hustle and bustle of Mumbai. With its classic architecture, well-maintained interiors, and peaceful ambiance, the church holds a timeless charm that draws both the faithful and visitors alike.

The parish community is warm and welcoming, and the Mass services are reverent and meaningful, often accompanied by soulful choir singing. The church compound is also spacious and clean, providing a calm and spiritual environment.

Whether you're attending Mass, seeking a moment of peace, or simply admiring its heritage, this church is truly a spiritual landmark in the Sion area.

featured_reviews.name: Cedric Noronha
featured_reviews.review_text: A Roman Catholic Church located in Borivli. Built in 1993 by the Salesians of Don Bosco, this church is dedicated to St. John Bosco. Its interior is spacious having wooden pews, stained glass window panes, ceiling fans, chandelier etc. The facade of this church is modern having a wall sculpture of Don Bosco along with young children. There is a grotto within the church premises. Also, there is a school attached to the church. Had attended a mass service in this church in English language. It is an ideal place for local devotees as well as people of other faith.

featured_reviews.name: Viveca Dourado
featured_reviews.review_text: Being a catholic, it’s with a heavy heart I write this. Regret having my wedding nuptials at St. John Bosco parish, Borivali. In the name of ‘nuptial fees/donation’ whatever they call it, we were exploited and charged 7 times more than the usual amount, and neighbouring parishes in other areas charge nothing close to that. This ‘fee’ did not include anything and additionally we were expected to give extra ‘fees’ to their Sacristy and Digital team. Deeply disappointed for a Catholic Church. Strongly encourage couples to sought other parishes for their Nuptials.

featured_reviews.name: Cedric Noronha
featured_reviews.review_text: A Syro Malabar Catholic Church located on a hillock in Borivli. Built in 2008, this church is affiliated to the Diocese of Kalyan and is a sub center of Our Lady of Immaculate Conception Church. Its interior is spacious and well lit having wooden pews, stained glass window panes, ceiling fans, chandelier etc. The facade of this church is simple & modern. There is a grotto within the church premises. Also, there is Holy Qurbana in Malayalam language everyday. Had attended a mass service in this church in English language. It is an ideal place for local devotees as well as people of other faith.
